sentence: This project uses human intestinal enteroids cells to measure infectious norovirus in water and studies how water treatments remove it.
This project measures air pollutants in a city over time and place using a mass spectrometer in a mobile lab vehicle.
This project studies how mutations in membrane protein transporters affect the direction of transport.
This project develops ways to generate and classify hyperspectral data using the scattering transform.
This project speeds up the analysis of whole genome sequencing data by improving a data structure called the Genotype Representation Graph.
This project brings together researchers to share ideas about statistical methods for genetics and genomics.
This project runs a network of telescopes to make images of black holes and monitor how they change over time.
This project studies how experiences in childhood affect the way the brain develops during adolescence.
This project studies how the pores on grasses called stomata open and close rapidly to control photosynthesis and water transport.
This project builds a flexible probe that senses and changes brain activity and works during functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging.
This project investigates microbial biodiversity in natural freshwater and intertidal ecosystems using genomics and imaging.
This project builds AI tools that speed up the discovery and making of molecules.
This project uses machine learning to predict how engineered biological circuits behave and to find design rules for them.
This project holds workshops on artificial intelligence and quantum computing, including quantum security and a cybersecurity hackathon.
This project builds machine learning methods that work backward from observations of a physical system to estimate its unknown parameters.
